# coSynth

A wavetable synthesizer that runs entirely in the browser, built to be operated
by an AI agent as a first-class user rather than only by hand.

## Read this first if you are an agent

The page registers tools on `document.modelContext` (the WebMCP API; the
pre-2026-07-21 `navigator.modelContext` spelling is also accepted). If your
client surfaces WebMCP tools, you already have them — call
`get_parameter_schema` with `{"format": "compact"}` to see all 224 parameters,
their units, ranges, defaults and which can be modulated, in one response.

If you are reading this file because you fetched the site: the app is a
client-rendered single-page app, so fetching `/` returns a ~1 KB shell with no
content. Nothing about the instrument is visible without executing its
JavaScript. This file exists so that fact does not leave you with nothing.

## What you can do

- **Discover** — `get_parameter_schema`, `get_synth_state`, `list_presets`,
  `get_ui_targets`
- **Change the sound** — `update_parameters` (atomic batches, raw units or
  choice labels), `set_modulation` (32-slot matrix), `load_preset`,
  `save_preset`
- **Hear and measure it** — `render_audio` renders offline by default: faster
  than real time, no user gesture needed, and it returns metrics describing
  envelope, level, spectrum and harmonic structure, so an agent with no ears can
  design to a target and check whether it got there
- **Play it live** — `play_notes` needs a human to click "CLICK TO START AUDIO"
  first, because browser autoplay policy requires a gesture. Offline rendering
  does not.
- **Teach** — `show_ui_guide` drives an interactive walkthrough of the real UI
- **Undo** — `get_history`, `navigate_history`, `replay_history`

## Notes that save you a round trip

- `env1` is the amplitude envelope, hardwired to voice level and lifetime.
  `env2`–`env6` and `lfo1`–`lfo8` do nothing until routed with `set_modulation`.
- Parameter values are raw units, not normalized: `env1.attack` is in seconds.
- `render_audio` metrics are computed on the render, not read back from the
  patch, so a decay figure depends on how long a note you asked for.

## Source

https://github.com/brunnolou/coSynth — but if you are evaluating the tool
surface, read the tool descriptions instead. They are meant to be enough on
their own, and where they are not, that is a bug worth reporting.
